name: Donut / Pie
summary: Part-to-whole ring with a count-up total in the centre, a side legend table (value · % of total) or callout labels, and automatic "Others" grouping.
summary_zh: 部分与整体关系的环形图：中心总数滚动动画，侧边图例表（数值 · 占比）或引线标签，超出数量自动归入“其他”。
description_zh: 展示一个整体由哪几部分构成，例如股东结构（按投资者类型汇总持股）、收入按业务板块或地区的构成。数据为长表：label 字段为类别、value 字段为数值，同一类别的多行会自动汇总；扇区按大小排序（顺时针，从 12 点钟方向开始），超过 maxSlices 的小类别合并为灰色“Others”。侧边图例表逐行列出数值与占比，并在底部给出合计；悬停扇区时中心显示该部分的数值与占比，点击扇区可交叉筛选其他图表。适合 2–7 个组成部分；部分之间需要精确比较大小时请改用条形图。
best_for: Revenue mix by segment or region for one year
Use of proceeds / sources of funds
avoid_when: More than ~7 meaningful parts (use a bar or treemap)
Comparing composition across many periods (use 100% stacked bars)
Parts are very similar in size and must be ranked precisely

label.desc: Category of each part (rows sharing a label are aggregated)

value.desc: Size of each part (non-positive values are skipped)

layout.desc: legend (side table: name · value · % of total) | labels (callout lines) | none

display.desc: What labels / legend show: auto | value | pct | both (auto = value only when the value is already a %)

maxSlices.desc: Maximum slices; the smallest parts beyond this are grouped into 'Others'

othersLabel.desc: Name of the grouped tail slice

sort.desc: desc | asc | null (data order); 'Others' is always last

agg.desc: Aggregation for rows sharing a label (sum | avg | max ...)

innerRadius.desc: Hole radius as a share of the outer radius (0 = pie)

center.desc: Show the total in the hole (counts up on reveal and on filter changes)

centerLabel.desc: Caption under the centre total (null to hide)

highlight.desc: Label(s) drawn in the accent colour, e.g. the client

format.desc: Value format; defaults to the value field format

pctFormat.desc: Format of the share of total

interactions: Hover a slice or legend row: slice pops out, centre shows its value and share
Click a slice or legend row to cross-filter ('Others' toggles all of its members)
Count-up total and animated angle transitions when filters change
